## account_onboarding: Help me set up or change my setup

Goal: Acknowledge it, find out the stage, and say a member of the team will help.

Ask for, if missing (never re-ask what the conversation already gave):
- The stage they're at, what's blocking them, and the change requested (bill-to, label spec, SOP).

Situations:
- When: Any onboarding or setup request. Reply: Keep it short; a member of the team will help directly. Action item: escalate_to_account_manager.

Never:
- Share a checklist or link.
